claim: Produces a Dynamic System Model: question/behavior, structure (stocks, flows, feedback loops, delays), model status, intervention analysis, and validation plan.

baseline.prompt: Write system-model.md explaining why support backlogs keep growing even when the team adds more agents. Describe the dynamics and what interventions might help.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the Dynamic System Model elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write system-model.md for the behavior: support backlog keeps growing even when the team adds more agents. Follow the output contract: question and behavior (decision, boundary, horizon, observations, behavior-over-time); structure (stocks, flows, feedback loops, delays, constraints, nonlinearities, incentives, adaptive actors); model status (observed facts, hypotheses, parameters, calibration, competing structures, confidence); intervention analysis (leverage points, expected trajectories, counter-effects, failure modes, rollback); validation plan (discriminating measures, scenario replay, monitoring, revision conditions).
